summary_en: IRISO Electronics authorized acquisition of up to 1,000,000 shares (4.7% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 3.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 20, 2026 and October 29, 2027, alongside a dividend adjustment to 100 yen per share for fiscal year ending March 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend Forecast Revision and Decisions on Share Buyback (Share Acquisition Based on Articles of Incorporation pursuant to Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, IRISO Electronics' board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 1,000,000 ordinary shares (4.7% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026) for a maximum total acquisition price of 3.0 billion yen. The shares will be acquired through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 20, 2026 through October 29, 2027. The company's outstanding share count excluding treasury stock was 21,350,458 shares as of September 30, 2026.

The company cited two primary reasons for the buyback program: first, to improve capital efficiency metrics such as ROE and ROIC; and second, to enhance shareholder returns. The board also modified its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, setting the year-end dividend at 100 yen per share for a total annual dividend of 100 yen, compared with the previous forecast that left the year-end dividend unspecified. The company stated that this dividend revision reflects stable profit distribution to shareholders and follows modification of earnings guidance announced on the same date.
